resource_and_provenance.user_constraint: Do not occupy other people's resources; no shared or third-party compute.

official_web_evidence.composition_and_scoring: local files and local deterministic/frozen scoring

known_discrepancies_and_limitations: The manual Math audit has not received independent second adjudication and cannot alter the official frozen score.

All selector grids and candidate pools were developed after aggregate target-benchmark exposure; cross-fitting prevents same-fold training leakage but does not make model selection a strict independent holdout result.
Official-web evidence was researched after target outcome exposure; 252/274, 255/274, 213/274, and 216/274 are projections rather than measured branch scores.
Three official-web answers conflict with all existing scored outcomes and require protocol-level re-adjudication before they can count as measured fixes.

closure_conclusion.interpretation: The strict score remains 205. Completed exploratory branches peak at 211; 0.80 appears only in non-deployable oracle/projection or audit-adjusted diagnostic calculations.
